newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tellabs estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tellabs estimates raised.

text.p: --Robert W. Baird analyst Ted Moreau said Thursday he raised his 1997 full-year earnings estimates for Tellabs Inc to $1.20 a share from $1.15 a share.
--Moreau said he also raised his estimate for 1998 to $1.60 a share from $1.50.
--In addition, Moreau said he raised the rating on the stock to the highest buy rating from accumulate. He said he has a price target for Tellabs of $50 to $55 over the next year.

--The move came after the company reported strong fourth quarter 1996 earnings. Moreau said he expects sales of the company's key products to continue to grow as marketing is expanded and additional features are added.
"Those (earnings) estimates still could be conservative," Moreau said.
--Tellabs, which provides products to increase telecommunications capacity, was trading two higher at 43-3/8 at midday.
